deploy-bot: Canary rollout v2026.04.12 to ap-south-1 complete. Kicking off post-deploy synthetic and smoke checks for embed and generate routes.
synth-bot: EMBED SYNTH ALERT: embeddings p99 latency spike + errors on ap-canary-2 (5m window) — 12 errors, sample: "inference: OOM while allocating quant buffer"
zara: only ap-canary-2? can someone check node memory and pod OOM events?
liam: metrics: ap-canary-1 mem 78%, ap-canary-2 mem 96% (OOM killed inference-worker), ap-canary-3 mem 81%. dmesg shows oom_killer targeted process "inference-worker" twice.
maya: this release included the quant allocator change (PR #4501). default flag `--quant_pool_mb=512` went live. some nodes with low allocatable memory will hit this.
infra-bot: node ap-canary-2 allocatable=6Gi, pod requests on node total ~5.9Gi. no node autoscaler event yet.
liam: options: (A) pin canary embed route to previous non-quant variant, (B) cordon/drain and restart pod with reduced quant_pool_mb, (C) scale node pool up (slower).
zara: pin + cleanup is lowest risk. we don't want repeated OOMs while rolling. pin embed -> rwd-embed-v1@sha256:prev111 and run a controlled drain on the impacted node.
deploy-bot: Applying route pin for canary embed -> rwd-embed-v1@sha256:prev111. Change applied.
synth-bot: POST-PIN SYNTH: embeddings p99 latency returned to baseline, errors 0 in last 60s, ap-canary-2 inference-worker restarted and holding.
maya: I'll open ENG-3555 to track the allocator fix and CI memory soak tests. patch branch `fix/quant-pool-default` created; ETA ~90m for CI and small canary re-run.
ops: schedule a node drain+resize later today; ops will run `kubectl drain` after confirming no active requests. also add a temporary node taint to avoid future scheduling until fixed.
liam: once hotfix passes, we can re-run quant variant on a small subset with increased node allocatable. keep release window open 2h for verification.
deploy-bot: Rollout note appended: embed route pinned in canary, synth probes green, ENG-3555 opened for quant allocator fix. Leaving thread open until hotfix merge or rollback decision.
